method.global_denominator: Percentages are women's share within each source role and medium in a monitoring round; values down a column do not sum to 100%.
method.local_selection: Six purposively selected RTHK English business-news articles from March–August 2026 illustrate role coding; they are not a representative Hong Kong sample.
method.local_unit: One named speaking person per article; repeated quotations in one article count once. A stable person_id deduplicates across articles.
method.local_roles: Specialist commentator interprets a wider issue using relevant knowledge. Institutional spokesperson speaks about or represents an organisation's own affairs. These local speaking-function labels adapt but do not exactly replicate GMMP's subject-priority coding.
method.gender_presentation: F and M require explicit female or male presentation in the selected text or an identified person's selected cross-reference. U means not established from selected text and does not describe a non-binary identity.
method.limits: Do not pool global and local data; infer source-selection motives; reconstruct GMMP person counts from rounded percentages; or claim independent second coding before it occurs.
